name: Salmon & Corn Rice with Fried Egg
steps: Rinse 1 cup rice and cook in a saucepan with 2 cups water; bring to boil, then simmer covered 15 minutes until water is absorbed.
While rice cooks, drain and rinse the canned salmon, flake it into a bowl.
In a large skillet, heat a splash of water, add 1 cup corn kernels and sauté 3 minutes until warmed.
Add the flaked salmon to the skillet, stir briefly to combine with corn, and season with a pinch of salt if desired.
When rice is done, fluff it and stir it into the salmon‑corn mixture; heat together for 2 minutes.
In the same skillet or a separate small pan, fry the egg sunny‑side‑up until whites set but yolk remains runny.
Slide the fried egg on top of the rice mixture, serve immediately.
image_prompt: flaked canned salmon and bright yellow corn kernels mixed with fluffy white rice, topped with a sunny‑side‑up egg showing a glossy, runny yolk
